title: Dorman Help 42057 PCV Valve Grommet for 1970-95 4Runner Land Cruiser Pickup etc
description_markdown:
This PCV valve grommet is designed to match the fit and function of the original grommet on specified vehicles, and is engineered for durability and reliable performance.

• Direct replacement - this PCV valve grommet is designed to match the fit and function of the original grommet on specified vehicles
• Restores functionality - this grommet is made to fit and fully restore part functionality after the original grommet fails
• Durable construction - this part is made from quality materials to ensure reliable performance and long service life
• Trustworthy quality - backed by team of product experts in the United States and more than a century of automotive experience

Application Summary:Toyota 4Runner 1995-84, Toyota Carina 1973-72, Toyota Celica 1985-77, 1974-71, Toyota Corolla 1982-71, Toyota Corona 1982-77, 1974-70, Toyota Cressida 1979-78, Toyota Land Cruiser 1984-73, Toyota Pickup 1995-70
